belief: Tom Holland starred in three solo Spider-Man movies: Spider-Man: Homecoming (2017), Spider-Man: Far From Home (2019), and Spider-Man: No Way Home (2021). All three were directed by Jon Watts.

belief: Andrew Garfield starred in three Spider-Man movies: The Amazing Spider-Man (2012), The Amazing Spider-Man 2 (2014), and Spider-Man: No Way Home (2021). The Amazing Spider-Man and The Amazing Spider-Man 2 were both directed by Marc Webb. Spider-Man: No Way Home was directed by Jon Watts.
